title: Deposit Schedule by Collection for the Home Purchase Agreement
content:
The Home Purchase Agreement deposit terms read the following figures for every collection: the initial earnest money percentage and its minimum, the business days allowed for the deposits due at signing, the extra deposit percentage for outside-lender or cash financing, the cap on initial earnest money for a buyer whose Calloway Home Mortgage rate lock is on the VA loan program, and the additional deposit percentage and its deadline.

## Figures

| Collection | Initial earnest money (% of contract price) | Minimum initial earnest money (USD) | Business days to post signing deposits | Outside-lender or cash extra deposit (% of contract price) | VA initial earnest money cap (USD) | Additional deposit (% of contract price) | Calendar days to post additional deposit after construction start |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 1.0 | 2500.00 | 3 | 2.0 | 2500.00 | 0.0 | 10 |
| Meadow Collection | 1.5 | 5000.00 | 3 | 2.0 | 2500.00 | 0.5 | 10 |
| Heritage Collection | 2.0 | 7500.00 | 3 | 2.0 | 5000.00 | 1.0 | 10 |
| Crestview Collection | 3.0 | 15000.00 | 3 | 3.0 | 5000.00 | 2.0 | 10 |
| Summit Collection | 5.0 | 25000.00 | 2 | 5.0 | 10000.00 | 3.0 | 10 |
| Reserve Collection | 10.0 | 75000.00 | 2 | 5.0 | 25000.00 | 5.0 | 10 |

## What each column is

- **Initial earnest money percentage**: initial earnest money as a percent of the contract price, the contract price being the base price plus the lot premium.
- **Minimum initial earnest money**: the lowest initial earnest money in US dollars, whatever the percentage gives.
- **Business days to post signing deposits**: business days after the contract date by which every deposit due at signing must post.
- **Outside-lender or cash extra deposit**: extra earnest money, as a percent of the contract price, due at signing when the buyer finances with an outside lender or pays cash.
- **VA initial earnest money cap**: the cap in US dollars on initial earnest money for a buyer whose rate lock with Calloway Home Mortgage is on the VA loan program.
- **Additional deposit**: the additional deposit due at construction start, as a percent of the contract price. A Pathway Collection agreement shows 0.0.
- **Calendar days to post additional deposit**: calendar days after the construction start date by which the additional deposit must post.

## Reading a row (hypothetical agreement)

For a hypothetical Summit Collection agreement, the row reads: initial earnest money percentage 5.0 with a minimum of 25000.00, signing deposits due within 2 business days, an outside-lender or cash extra deposit of 5.0 percent, a VA cap of 10000.00, and an additional deposit of 3.0 percent due within 10 calendar days after construction starts.
